name: logo-design
description: Generates a brand mark: three concepts drawn as SVG, then the winner shipped as a docs/design/LOGO.md brief plus full, stacked, mark-only, wordmark-only, mono, and favicon variants. Renders a contact sheet and, when Playwright MCP is available, self-critiques with vision before presenting. Scoped to geometric, monogram, wordmark, and abstract marks; refuses pictorial, mascot, and emblem work. Includes logo-review for auditing existing marks.
